about.ex: The trip takes about an hour.

accessible.ex: The library is accessible to all students.

active.ex: This volcano is still active today.

added.ex: He added that the shop would open late.

addition.en: in addition to: as well as
addition.ex: In addition to French, she speaks Italian.

ago.ex: I moved here ten years ago.

almost.ex: The train was almost empty at midnight.

ancient.ex: We visited the ruins of an ancient city.

approximately.ex: The journey takes approximately two hours.

area.ex: This area is popular with young families.

areas.ex: This area is popular with young families.

around.ex: Around fifty people came to the meeting.

as.en: in the same way; in the role of

at.es: a (at the same rate: al mismo ritmo)
at.hi: पर (at the same rate: उसी दर पर)
at.ja: 〜で（at the same rate：同じ割合で）
at.zh: 以（at the same rate：以相同速度）

atlas.en: a book or collection of maps
atlas.ex: I looked up Peru in my old atlas.

available.en: able to be used or obtained

badly.en: very much; in a serious way
badly.ex: The project is badly behind schedule.

be.ex: Try to be on time tomorrow.

been.ex: It has been a busy week.

before.ex: I had seen him two days before.

bigger.ex: It was a big decision for the family.

bit.en: bit by bit: slowly, in small parts
bit.ex: She paid back the money bit by bit.
bit.zh: bit by bit：一點一點地；逐步

boats.ex: Fishing boats returned to the harbour at dawn.

bottom.en: at the lowest part, the sea floor
bottom.ex: Put the heavy books on the bottom shelf.

bringing.en: bring to light: make something known
bringing.ex: The report brought several problems to light.

cables.en: thick wires that carry power or signals
cables.ex: Workers laid new cables under the street.

canyon.en: a deep valley with steep sides
canyon.ex: The river runs through a narrow canyon.

canyon-esque.en: like the Grand Canyon in look
canyon-esque.ex: The desert had a canyon-esque landscape of red cliffs.
canyon-esque.ja: グランドキャニオンのような

canyons.ex: Rivers cut deep canyons into the rock.

carried.ex: The tests were carried out last week.

century.en: a period of one hundred years
century.ex: The church was built in the 12th century.
century.zh: 世紀（a quarter of a century：二十五年）

coast.ex: We drove along the coast all afternoon.

cold-water.ex: Cold-water fish live in the northern seas.

collaboration.ex: The film was made in collaboration with local artists.

college.ex: She studies history at a local college.
college.ja: カレッジ（Trinity College：トリニティ・カレッジ）
college.zh: 學院（Trinity College：都柏林三一學院）

combined.ex: She combined flour and eggs in a bowl.

compared.en: said something is like something else
compared.ex: He compared the city to a busy anthill.

comprehensively.ex: The topic was comprehensively covered in the book.

example.en: The new law was comprehensively reviewed by experts.
example.zh: 這項新法律經過專家全面審查。

note.meaning: 全面地、徹底地，涵蓋所有部分。
note.usage: 常修飾動詞的被動式，如 be comprehensively mapped/reviewed，語氣正式。

noteEn.usage: Often used before past participles: comprehensively mapped, comprehensively tested.

noteEs.exampleTr: La nueva ley fue revisada exhaustivamente por expertos.
noteEs.meaning: De manera completa, abarcando todas las partes.
noteEs.usage: Suele modificar verbos en pasiva: be comprehensively mapped; es formal.

noteHi.exampleTr: नए क़ानून की विशेषज्ञों ने व्यापक समीक्षा की।
noteHi.meaning: पूरी तरह से, हर हिस्से को शामिल करते हुए।
noteHi.usage: अक्सर कर्मवाच्य क्रियाओं के साथ आता है, जैसे comprehensively mapped।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい法律は専門家によって包括的に見直された。
noteJa.meaning: すべての部分を含めて、包括的に。
noteJa.usage: 受動態の動詞を修飾することが多い（be comprehensively mapped）。フォーマル。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 법은 전문가들에 의해 포괄적으로 검토되었다.
noteKo.usage: 주로 수동태 동사를 꾸민다(be comprehensively mapped). 격식체.

conducted.ex: The survey was conducted by phone.

consequently.ex: It rained heavily; consequently, the match was cancelled.

coral.en: hard sea material made by tiny animals
coral.ex: Colourful fish swim around the coral.

cork's.en: belonging to Cork, a city in Ireland

data.en: facts and numbers collected for study
data.ex: The app collects data about your sleep.

datasets.ex: The team shared its datasets online.

deep.ex: The lake is very deep in the middle.

deep-sea.en: in the deep parts of the ocean
deep-sea.ex: Deep-sea fish often glow in the dark.

depth.ex: The pool has a depth of two metres.

depths.ex: Whales can dive to great depths.

described.ex: He described the hotel as quiet and clean.

designate.en: officially name or choose for a purpose
designate.ex: The city will designate this park a nature area.

designating.ex: They are designating new bike lanes downtown.

disparate.ex: The book brings together disparate ideas.

example.en: The festival brings together disparate groups of people.
example.zh: 這個節日把各種截然不同的人群聚在一起。

note.meaning: 本質上截然不同、難以相比的。
note.usage: 正式用語，多修飾複數名詞，如 disparate groups/sources/technologies。

noteEn.usage: Formal; usually goes before plural nouns like groups or sources.

noteEs.exampleTr: El festival reúne a grupos de personas muy dispares.
noteEs.usage: Palabra formal, suele ir con sustantivos plurales: disparate groups/sources.

noteHi.exampleTr: यह उत्सव बहुत अलग-अलग लोगों के समूहों को साथ लाता है।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द, अधिकतर बहुवचन संज्ञाओं के साथ: disparate groups।

noteJa.exampleTr: その祭りはさまざまに異なる人々の集団を結びつける。
noteJa.meaning: 互いに大きく異なる、異質な。
noteJa.usage: フォーマルな語で、複数名詞を修飾することが多い（disparate groups）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 축제는 서로 매우 다른 사람들을 한데 모은다.
noteKo.usage: 격식 있는 말로 주로 복수 명사를 꾸민다(disparate groups).

dormant.en: not active now, but could be later
dormant.ex: The volcano has been dormant for centuries.

example.en: The seeds lay dormant until the spring rain.
example.zh: 種子一直休眠到春雨來臨。

note.meaning: 休眠的；暫時不活動但可能再活躍的。
note.usage: 用於火山、種子、計畫等；lie/remain dormant 為常見搭配，與 extinct 相對。

noteEn.meaning: Not active now, but able to become active again.
noteEn.usage: Common with volcanoes and seeds: lie dormant, remain dormant.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las semillas permanecieron latentes hasta la lluvia de primavera.
noteEs.meaning: Inactivo por ahora, pero puede volver a activarse.
noteEs.usage: Se usa con volcanes, semillas, planes; lie/remain dormant es común.

noteHi.exampleTr: बीज वसंत की बारिश तक सुप्त पड़े रहे।
noteHi.meaning: सुप्त; अभी निष्क्रिय पर बाद में सक्रिय हो सकता है।
noteHi.usage: ज्वालामुखी, बीज आदि के लिए; lie/remain dormant आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 種は春の雨まで休眠していた。
noteJa.meaning: 休眠中の、今は活動していないが再び活動しうる。
noteJa.usage: 火山・種子・計画などに使う。lie/remain dormant がよく使われる。

noteKo.exampleTr: 씨앗은 봄비가 올 때까지 휴면 상태였다.
noteKo.meaning: 휴면 상태의, 지금은 활동하지 않지만 다시 활동할 수 있는.
noteKo.usage: 화산, 씨앗, 계획 등에 쓰며 lie/remain dormant가 흔하다.

dwarfs.ex: The new tower dwarfs the old church.

efforts.ex: Thanks for your efforts on the project.

electricity.en: power used for lights and machines
electricity.ex: The storm cut off electricity to many homes.

enhanced.ex: New software enhanced the photo quality.

escarpments.ex: Birds nest on the rocky escarpments.

expected.ex: We expect the results on Monday.

extending.ex: The garden extends to the river.

extinct.ex: The town is built on an extinct volcano.

example.en: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
example.zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前滅絕了。

note.meaning: （火山）不再活動的；（物種）已滅絕的。
note.usage: 描述火山時表示永不再噴發，與 dormant（暫時休眠）不同；也常說 become/go extinct。

noteEn.meaning: No longer active or alive; gone forever.
noteEn.usage: Use for volcanoes that will never erupt again, or animals that no longer exist.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los dinosaurios se extinguieron hace millones de años.
noteEs.meaning: (Volcán) que ya no está activo; (especie) que ha desaparecido.
noteEs.usage: Con volcanes significa que no volverá a entrar en erupción, a diferencia de dormant. Se usa become extinct.

noteHi.exampleTr: डायनासोर लाखों साल पहले विलुप्त हो गए।
noteHi.usage: ज्वालामुखी के लिए इसका मतलब है फिर कभी नहीं फटेगा; dormant से अलग। become extinct आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 恐竜は何百万年も前に絶滅した。
noteJa.meaning: （火山が）活動を終えた；（生物が）絶滅した。
noteJa.usage: 火山では二度と噴火しない意味で、dormant（休眠中）とは異なる。become extinct の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: 화산에 쓰면 다시 분화하지 않는다는 뜻으로 dormant(휴면)와 다르다. become extinct 형태가 흔하다.

facilitate.en: to make something easier to happen
facilitate.ex: The new app will facilitate online bookings.

far.ex: This is far better than the old version.
far.ja: はるかに（far from：決して〜ない）
syn: a lot (far from: not at all)

farms.en: wind farms: groups of wind turbines

features.en: parts or functions of a product
features.ex: This phone has many useful features.

first.ex: It was her first trip to Ireland.

fishing.ex: Fishing is important to the island's economy.

floor.ex: Crabs walk slowly across the ocean floor.

formed.ex: The lake was formed by a glacier.

forms.en: form part of: is one part of
forms.ex: This course forms part of the degree.
forms.zh: form part of：構成…的一部分

fragile.ex: Coral reefs are very fragile ecosystems.

example.en: Handle the glass carefully; it is very fragile.
example.zh: 小心拿這個玻璃，它很易碎。

note.meaning: 脆弱的、易碎或易受損的。
note.usage: 可形容物品、生態、健康或局勢，如 fragile ecosystem/peace。

noteEn.usage: Used for objects, nature and situations: a fragile ecosystem.

noteEs.exampleTr: Maneja el vidrio con cuidado; es muy frágil.
noteEs.meaning: Frágil, que se rompe o daña fácilmente.
noteEs.usage: Se usa con objetos, ecosistemas o situaciones: fragile ecosystem/peace.

noteHi.exampleTr: काँच को सावधानी से पकड़ो; यह बहुत नाज़ुक है।
noteHi.meaning: नाज़ुक, आसानी से टूटने या नुकसान होने वाला।
noteHi.usage: वस्तुओं, पारिस्थितिकी, स्वास्थ्य या शांति के लिए: fragile ecosystem।

noteJa.exampleTr: そのガラスは壊れやすいので注意して扱って。
noteJa.meaning: 壊れやすい、傷つきやすい。
noteJa.usage: 物・生態系・健康・情勢などに使う（fragile ecosystem）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 유리는 깨지기 쉬우니 조심해서 다뤄라.
noteKo.usage: 물건, 생태계, 건강, 상황 등에 쓴다(fragile ecosystem).

freely.ex: The software is freely available online.

furrows.en: long narrow cuts in the ground
furrows.ex: The tractor left deep furrows in the field.

furthermore.ex: The flat is cheap; furthermore, it is central.

geological.en: about rocks and the earth's structure
geological.ex: The museum has a large geological collection.

goes.ex: The road goes all the way to the coast.

gouged.ex: The glacier gouged a valley in the rock.

grand.en: part of the name Grand Canyon

group.en: a number of people or things together
group.ex: A group of students visited the museum.

habitats.en: natural homes of animals or plants
habitats.ex: Many birds are losing their habitats.

had.en: possessed; was involved (had a hand in)
had.ex: She had a key role in the project.

has.en: owns or holds; also forms perfect tense

have.ja: 持つ；〜しなければならない

help.ex: Volunteers help older people with shopping.

hidden.en: not easy to see or find
hidden.ex: We found a hidden path behind the trees.

huge.ex: They won a huge prize in the lottery.

iceberg.en: a huge piece of floating ice
iceberg.ex: An iceberg sank the famous ship.

identify.ex: We need to identify the cause of the problem.

important.ex: It is important to drink water.

incorporated.ex: Her ideas were incorporated into the final plan.

incrementally.ex: Prices rose incrementally over the year.

example.en: The company improved its software incrementally.
example.zh: 這家公司逐步改進了它的軟體。

note.meaning: 逐步地、一點一點增加地。
note.usage: 強調以小幅度、分階段推進，如 increase/improve incrementally。

noteEn.meaning: Slowly, in small steps over time.
noteEn.usage: Use with verbs like increase, improve, grow.

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa mejoró su software de forma gradual.
noteEs.usage: Destaca un avance por etapas: increase/improve incrementally.

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी ने अपने सॉफ़्टवेयर को धीरे-धीरे बेहतर बनाया।
noteHi.usage: छोटे क़दमों में प्रगति पर ज़ोर: increase/improve incrementally।

noteJa.exampleTr: その会社はソフトウェアを段階的に改良した。
noteJa.usage: 小さな段階で進むことを強調（improve incrementally）。

inform.ex: Your feedback will inform our next design.

information.ex: The website has useful information for travellers.

institute.en: an organisation for research or study
institute.ex: He works at a science institute.

instrumental.en: very important in making something happen
instrumental.ex: She was instrumental in starting the club.

example.en: He was instrumental in building the new school.
example.zh: 他在興建新學校一事上功不可沒。

note.meaning: 起關鍵作用的、有重要幫助的。
note.usage: 固定用法 be instrumental in (doing) sth。

noteEn.meaning: Very important in making something happen.
noteEn.usage: Use be instrumental in doing something.

noteEs.exampleTr: Él fue fundamental en la construcción de la nueva escuela.
noteEs.meaning: Que tiene un papel clave para lograr algo.
noteEs.usage: Se usa be instrumental in (doing) algo.

noteHi.exampleTr: नए स्कूल के निर्माण में उसकी अहम भूमिका रही।
noteHi.meaning: किसी काम में अहम भूमिका निभाने वाला।
noteHi.usage: be instrumental in (doing) something रूप में प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼は新しい学校の建設に大きく貢献した。
noteJa.usage: be instrumental in (doing) の形で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그는 새 학교 건립에 결정적인 역할을 했다.

integrated.en: made part of something from the start
integrated.ex: Solar panels are integrated into the roof.

interconnectors.ex: New interconnectors carry power between countries.

joined.ex: She joined the club last year.

km.ex: The beach is 5 km from the hotel.

land.en: the dry part of the earth
land.ex: After weeks at sea, they saw land.

landscape.en: the shape and look of an area

landslides.ex: Heavy rain caused landslides in the hills.

last.ex: I last saw him two years ago.

left.en: caused someone to be in a situation
left.ex: The storm left thousands without power.

lie.en: to be in a certain position or situation
lie.ex: The answer may lie in better planning.

life.ex: The island is full of plant life.

light.ex: New facts came to light last week.

likened.en: said one thing is like another
likened.ex: Critics likened her voice to an angel's.

example.en: She likened the busy office to a beehive.
example.zh: 她把忙碌的辦公室比作蜂窩。

note.usage: 固定用法 liken A to B，語氣比 compare 更正式。

noteEn.meaning: To say one thing is like another.
noteEn.usage: Use the pattern liken A to B; it is more formal than compare.

noteEs.exampleTr: Ella comparó la oficina ajetreada con una colmena.
noteEs.meaning: Comparar una cosa con otra por su parecido.
noteEs.usage: Siempre liken A to B; más formal que compare.

noteHi.exampleTr: उसने व्यस्त दफ़्तर की तुलना मधुमक्खी के छत्ते से की।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ की तुलना दूसरी से करना, समानता बताना।
noteHi.usage: हमेशा liken A to B रूप में; compare से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼女は忙しいオフィスを蜂の巣にたとえた。
noteJa.meaning: AをBになぞらえる、たとえる。
noteJa.usage: liken A to B の形で使い、compare より硬い表現。

noteKo.usage: liken A to B 형태로 쓰며 compare보다 격식체.

long-extinct.ex: Sheep graze on a long-extinct volcano.

look.en: to see (look after: take care of)
look.ex: She looks after her younger brother.

made.ex: My sister made a cake for me.

map.ex: Can you show me on the map?

mapping.ex: Drone mapping is fast and cheap.

maps.ex: We bought maps of the city.

marine.en: part of the name Marine Institute
marine.zh: Marine Institute：海洋研究所（機構名）

marks.ex: The dog left muddy marks on the floor.

mass.en: land mass: a large area of land
mass.ex: Australia is a huge land mass.

million.ex: The city has over one million people.

nets.en: fishing tools made of crossed strings
nets.ex: The fishermen repaired their nets on the beach.

new.ex: The city opened a new library.

now.ex: The shop is now open on Sundays.

offshore.en: in the sea, away from the coast
offshore.ex: They work on an offshore oil platform.

old.ex: The old system was too slow.

online.ex: Teenagers spend hours online every day.

out.ex: He pointed out a mistake in my essay.

part.ex: This room is part of the old house.

piecemeal.en: bit by bit, not as one plan
piecemeal.ex: The old town was rebuilt piecemeal.

example.en: The city's roads were repaired piecemeal over many years.
example.zh: 這座城市的道路多年來被零星地修補。

note.meaning: 零零碎碎地、一點一點地進行，缺乏整體規劃。
note.usage: 可作副詞（done piecemeal）或形容詞（a piecemeal approach），常帶負面意味。

noteEn.meaning: Bit by bit, in separate parts, not all together.
noteEn.usage: Use as adverb or adjective; it often sounds a little negative.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las calles de la ciudad se repararon de forma fragmentada durante años.
noteEs.meaning: Poco a poco, por partes, sin un plan global.
noteEs.usage: Puede ser adverbio (done piecemeal) o adjetivo (a piecemeal approach); a menudo negativo.

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर की सड़कों की मरम्मत कई सालों में टुकड़ों में की गई।
noteHi.meaning: टुकड़ों में, बिना पूरी योजना के।
noteHi.usage: क्रियाविशेषण (done piecemeal) या विशेषण (a piecemeal approach) के रूप में; अक्सर नकारात्मक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 市の道路は何年もかけて断片的に修理された。
noteJa.meaning: 全体計画なしに少しずつ、断片的に。
noteJa.usage: 副詞（done piecemeal）にも形容詞（a piecemeal approach）にもなる。否定的な響きが多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 도시의 도로는 수년에 걸쳐 단편적으로 보수되었다.
noteKo.usage: 부사(done piecemeal)나 형용사(a piecemeal approach)로 쓰이며 흔히 부정적 뉘앙스.

pipelines.en: long pipes carrying gas or oil
pipelines.ex: Gas pipelines run under the sea.

places.ex: It is a great place to live.

planning.ex: They are waiting for planning permission.
planning.ja: 都市計画（planning permission：建築許可）

plunging.ex: The cliffs plunge into the ocean.

poised.ex: The team is poised to win the title.
poised.ja: 〜しようとしている（be poised to）

example.en: The team is poised to win the championship.
example.zh: 這支隊伍即將贏得冠軍。

note.meaning: 準備就緒、即將（做某事）的。
note.usage: 常用 be poised to do sth 或 be poised for sth，表示即將發生。

noteEn.meaning: Ready and about to do something.
noteEn.usage: Use be poised to do something or be poised for something.

noteEs.exampleTr: El equipo está a punto de ganar el campeonato.
noteEs.meaning: Listo o a punto de hacer algo.
noteEs.usage: Se usa be poised to do o be poised for algo.

noteHi.exampleTr: टीम चैंपियनशिप जीतने के लिए तैयार है।
noteHi.meaning: कुछ करने के लिए तैयार, होने ही वाला।
noteHi.usage: be poised to do या be poised for के रूप में प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: そのチームは優勝目前だ。
noteJa.meaning: ～する態勢が整った、まさに～しようとしている。
noteJa.usage: be poised to do / be poised for の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 팀은 우승을 눈앞에 두고 있다.
noteKo.usage: be poised to do 또는 be poised for 형태로 쓴다.

previous.ex: The previous owner lived here for years.

produced.ex: The team produced a short video.

product.ex: This product is made in Japan.

professor.ex: The professor gave a talk on climate.

protected.ex: The forest is protected by law.

publicly.en: by the government or for the public
publicly.zh: 由公家地（publicly funded：公共資金資助的）

pulling.ex: Horses were pulling a heavy cart.

quarter.ex: A quarter of the crop was lost.

ravaged.ex: The forest was ravaged by fire.

example.en: The town was ravaged by floods last winter.

paragraphs: Scientists have made new maps of the deep sea floor near Ireland. The Marine Institute and University College Cork made the maps. Anyone can see them online.
Ireland's sea area is about ten times bigger than its land. In some places, the sea is more than 5 km deep.
The maps show deep canyons. One scientist said they look like the Grand Canyon. They also show old volcanoes. These volcanoes stopped about 60 million years ago.
The maps will help people plan wind farms and cables under the sea. They will also help protect sea life, like cold-water coral. This work is very important for Ireland.

For the first time, Ireland has a full map of its deep sea floor. The Marine Institute and a team at University College Cork made the map, and it is now part of the Marine Atlas of Ireland, which anyone can use online.

Ireland's sea area is about ten times larger than its land. It goes almost 1,000 km from the coast and is more than 5 km deep in places. Before, deep areas were mapped bit by bit over 25 years, using different technology. The team joined all this information into one clear map.

The map shows huge underwater canyons in the south, which Professor Andy Wheeler compared to the Grand Canyon. In the far west there are old volcanoes that were last active about 60 million years ago. There are also marks left by icebergs and signs of underwater landslides.

The map will help with planning offshore wind farms, cables and pipelines. It will also help protect deep-sea habitats such as cold-water coral reefs, which were badly damaged by fishing boats pulling nets along the sea floor.

Ireland's deep seabed has been comprehensively mapped for the first time, revealing canyons, extinct volcanoes and the scars of ancient icebergs. The new maps, produced by the Marine Institute and University College Cork's Marine Geosciences Research Group, have been added to the publicly available Marine Atlas of Ireland.

Ireland's marine territory is about ten times the size of its land area, stretching almost 1,000 km offshore and reaching depths of more than 5 km. Previous deep-water surveys were carried out piecemeal over about 25 years using different technologies, so the team enhanced and combined the data into a single high-resolution product.

Professor Andy Wheeler described the submarine canyons in the south as "Grand Canyon-esque". Further west lie volcanoes that were last active around 60 million years ago, as well as rift valleys and slopes shaped by underwater landslides.

The maps are expected to support the planning of offshore wind farms, telecom cables and electricity interconnectors. They will also be essential for designating marine protected areas to safeguard habitats such as cold-water coral reefs, which have been badly damaged by bottom trawling.

The work, undertaken by the Marine Institute and University College Cork's Marine Geosciences Research Group, now forms part of the freely accessible Marine Atlas of Ireland.

The State's marine territory dwarfs its land mass roughly tenfold, extending almost 1,000 km offshore and plunging beyond 5 km in depth. Professor Andy Wheeler likened the submarine canyons in the far south to the Grand Canyon. Further west lie volcanoes dormant for some 60 million years, alongside rift valleys and escarpments sculpted by submarine landslides.

The atlas is poised to inform the routing of offshore wind farms, telecom cables and interconnectors. It will also underpin efforts to designate marine protected areas, shielding fragile habitats such as cold-water coral reefs that have been ravaged by bottom trawling.
